title: Front Porch Lemonade
style: country americana, banjo, slide guitar, fiddle, summer porch vibe, warm female vocal, hand claps, foot stomps, sing-along chorus
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Mason jar sweating in the July heat
Fireflies dancing down the dusty street
Daddy's old radio crackling out a tune
Mama humming up against the moon

[Verse 2]
Kids running barefoot through the sprinkler spray
Grandpa whittling time the slow old way
There ain't a thing in this world I'd trade
For a porch and a glass of lemonade

[Chorus]
Front porch lemonade
Sweet as the life we made
Nothing fancy, nothing fast
Just the kind of love that'll last
Front porch lemonade
In the soft cicada shade
If heaven's got a flavor, baby
I bet it tastes like this

[Verse 3]
Neighbors waving from across the lawn
Somebody's dog won't quit going on
There's a peach pie cooling on the windowsill
And time is moving easy, slow, and still

[Chorus]
Front porch lemonade
Sweet as the life we made
Nothing fancy, nothing fast
Just the kind of love that'll last
Front porch lemonade
In the soft cicada shade
If heaven's got a flavor, baby
I bet it tastes like this

[Bridge]
They can keep their cities, keep their shine
I got everything I need on this old pine

[Outro]
Just a front porch lemonade kind of life
Just a front porch lemonade kind of life
